# UITextareaComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Multi-line text field of a script UI; the callback gets the text whenever it changes.

## Methods

### background {#background}

::: member

Shows or hides the dark background and border.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether they are drawn |

**Returns** [`UITextareaComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextareaComponent) — this text area

:::

### padding {#padding}

::: member

Sets the space between the border and the text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | space in pixels |

**Returns** [`UITextareaComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextareaComponent) — this text area

:::

### lineHeight {#lineheight}

::: member

Sets the height of a line.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lineHeight` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | line height in pixels |

**Returns** [`UITextareaComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextareaComponent) — this text area

:::

### textColor {#textcolor}

::: member

Sets the color of the text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `textColor` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |
| `textShadow` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the text has a shadow |

**Returns** [`UITextareaComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextareaComponent) — this text area

| `textColor` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

### text {#text}

::: member

| `text` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text; `\n` starts a new line |

:::

### getText {#gettext}

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the whole text; lines are separated by `\n`

::: member

### wrap {#wrap}

::: member

| `wrapping` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether long lines wrap at the component width |
